svg.title: Single-slit intensity
svg.desc: Intensity versus sin θ for a single slit of width D. The central maximum is twice as wide as the others, and the intensity falls to zero at sin θ = ±λ/D, ±2λ/D, ±3λ/D. The secondary maxima are much dimmer than the central one. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: A narrower slit spreads the far-field pattern
Fixed λ = 550 nm; a decreases from 6λ to 2λ. I/I central peak = (sin β/β)², β = πa sin θ/λ. First
minima: sin θ = ±λ/a. Each curve is peak-normalized.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
